nary_nodes.label: Spain beats Argentina in final
evidence: Lionel Messi could have ended all debate over who is the greatest player of all time by winning another World Cup with Argentina on Sunday, but he was left in tears following Spain's 1-0 win.
Ten-man Argentina did not lay a glove on Spain at the MetLife Stadium, and were lucky to survive until the 106th minute, when Ferran Torres finally broke the deadlock.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Football matches are athletic competitions, fitting SportsEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Argentina vs England semi-final
evidence: Messi, now 39, dragged the holders to another final, scoring eight goals and also providing two assists in the dramatic late comeback against England in the semi-finals.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Football matches are athletic competitions, fitting SportsEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Argentina wins 2022 World Cup
evidence: But the dream of lifting the trophy again, four years after he inspired Argentina to victory in Qatar, ultimately proved too good to be true.
That victory allowed him to emulate Diego Maradona, who dragged Argentina to glory in 1986.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Football matches are athletic competitions, fitting SportsEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Argentina loses 1990 final
evidence: Maradona's Argentina returned to the final as holders in 1990, only to deliver a dreadful, cynical display in losing 1-0 to West Germany, a game they finished with nine men.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Football matches are athletic competitions, fitting SportsEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Argentina loses 2014 final
evidence: If Messi does still have any doubters, they may point to the fact that he has now lost two of his finals, with this defeat following the loss to Germany in 2014.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Football matches are athletic competitions, fitting SportsEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Argentina vs Chile Copa America final
evidence: But with Argentina he had already lost three major finals, including the 2014 World Cup final, when he came to the MetLife Stadium for the Copa America Centenario decider against Chile in 2016.
The game ended 0-0, before Messi missed his penalty in the shootout as Argentina lost again.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Football matches are athletic competitions, fitting SportsEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Messi announces retirement
evidence: Sunday's final took place back at the same stadium where he sensationally announced his retirement from international football aged 29 in 2016.
"For me the national team is over," he said then.

nary_nodes.label: Messi's late career revival
evidence: He went on to enjoy an incredible late career revival with his country, winning the Copa America back-to-back in 2021 and 2024, either side of the 2022 World Cup.

nary_nodes.label: Messi scores hat-trick vs Algeria

nary_nodes.type_justification: Football matches are athletic competitions, fitting SportsEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Messi's World Cup career ends

evidence: It was hard not to come to the conclusion that he ended up hindering his side once they were down to 10 men – he was left as their lone forward, when in any other circumstances coach Lionel Scaloni would surely have sent on the fresh legs of Lautaro Martinez in attack.
